messages:
maya: Heads-up — our weekly eng sync (RFC reviews + triage) is showing different times for folks in APAC after the recurring invite rolled over last night. Anyone else seeing this? :confused:
kevin: Yep saw it. My calendar showed 10:30am -> then flipped to 9:30am for me this morning. Looks like the recurrence was created in PST but set to "floating"? :eyebrow_raised:
sarah: Same. I think the original organizer created it before DST change and GCal applied a different offset for some attendees. APAC folks are getting it at the old offset. :frowning:
aj: Is this the event that was created from the RFC review template? The template sets "Time zone: (None)" in the UI sometimes. If it's timezone-less, GCAL treats it weirdly across clients.
maya: It was from the RFC template yes. Calendar-bot created it on Feb 12. We have a couple of contractors in IST and one in JST complaining. We need the sync to stay at 17:00 UTC every Tue. Current recurrence is "weekly on Tue at 5pm" but local times are shifting.
kevin: Quick workaround: duplicate the series, set the event timezone explicitly to UTC, save, then delete the old series. That forces GCAL to anchor to UTC. I did that for a separate meeting and APAC folks saw the fixed time.
sarah: Can you share step-by-step? Some folks are not comfortable deleting series.
kevin: Steps I used:
```
1) Open event -> More actions -> Duplicate
2) In duplicate, open "Time zone" and set to "UTC" (instead of default)
3) Save -> choose "All events" when prompted
4) Verify local times for a couple test accounts
5) Delete old series
```
maya: Thanks. I'll try. Does this break old Zoom links? We use the same Zoom meeting for the series.
aj: If the Zoom meeting was created as a recurring Zoom meeting with a single meeting ID, duplicating the Google event keeps the join URL. If the meeting uses a calendar-generated ad-hoc link, double-check the join URL after duplication.
calendar-bot: Reminder: recurring Zoom meetings created via integration keep the same meeting ID unless the event is recreated as a new Zoom meeting.
sarah: I tested in my calendar — duplicate + set timezone to UTC preserved the join URL. APAC folks now see the slot at 17:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
maya: OK I'll schedule a maintenance window today to update the series and post a note in #general. Also adding an agenda line: quick RFC review (15m), triage (25m), async items to follow.
aj: One more thought — for future invites, can we default the RFC template to include an explicit timezone field (UTC) so this doesn't slip?
kevin: +1. Maybe update the template in Drive / Calendar templates. I can PR to the docs.
sarah: Also suggest adding a line in the invite text: "If your local time looks wrong after DST, re-import calendar or reach out to eng-platform." Small help text reduces pings.
maya: Good plan. I'll update the template and create a tiny how-to doc with the steps. Will ping when done. :thumbsup:
kevin: Thanks — and if anyone sees oddities after I update, ping me and I can help verify account views (I have both PST and CET test accounts).
calendar-bot: Event updated: "Eng weekly sync (RFC + triage)" - series recreated with TZ=UTC by maya at 1776557689.
